field.label: Block type
field.help: Response returned for blocked queries: "zeroIP" answers with 0.0.0.0/::, "nxDomain" answers with NXDOMAIN, "refused" answers with REFUSED for every query type (note: some clients treat REFUSED as a server failure and fall back to another DNS server, bypassing blocking), or enter a comma separated list of destination IP addresses (include both an IPv4 and an IPv6 to cover all query types) to point blocked names at your own "blocked" web server.

field.label: Block TTL
field.help: TTL returned for blocked queries, e.g. 6h.

field.label: List refresh period
field.help: Interval at which deny/allow lists are refreshed from their sources, e.g. 4h. Set to 0 to disable periodic refresh.

field.label: List loading strategy
field.help: How lists load at startup: blocking waits for all of them before serving, failOnError aborts startup if one fails to load, fast serves immediately and loads them in the background.

field.label: Max errors per source
field.help: Number of parse errors tolerated in a single list before it is treated as invalid. Use -1 to disable the limit.

field.label: Load concurrency
field.help: Maximum number of lists processed in parallel.

field.label: Download timeout
field.help: Timeout for downloading each list URL. Increase for large files or slow links, e.g. 60s.

field.label: Download attempts
field.help: Maximum number of download attempts for each list URL (including the first attempt).

field.label: Download cooldown
field.help: Wait time between failed download attempts.

field.label: Download write timeout
field.help: Write timeout of Blocky's own HTTP server (REST API, metrics, DoH). Blocky reads it from here, it does not apply to list downloads.

field.label: Download read timeout
field.help: Read timeout of Blocky's own HTTP server (REST API, metrics, DoH). Blocky reads it from here, it does not apply to list downloads. Use 0 to disable.

field.label: Download header timeout
field.help: Header read timeout of Blocky's own HTTP server (REST API, metrics, DoH). Blocky reads it from here, it does not apply to list downloads. Use -1 to disable.

field.label: Download cache path
field.help: Optional directory under /var for an on-disk cache of downloaded lists. When set, Blocky uses HTTP conditional requests to skip re-downloading unchanged lists, and can serve a list from disk when its source is temporarily unreachable. When empty (default), downloads are stateless and nothing is written to disk.
